title: Bloodline Resonance
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji touched the jade slip inscribed with the Chen family's bloodline mark, a blurred image flashed through his mind—Chen Nian was in some dark stone chamber, holding a fragment identical to the one in his hand.

text.content: The air deep within the ruins was cold and damp. Chen Ji's hand holding the Tianji Record trembled slightly. The faint glow emanating from the fourth page was not a fluctuation of spiritual energy, but a pull he had never felt before—as if something deep within his bloodline was calling out. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently within the Tianji Record, yet for once, he fell into silence.

"This is..." Chen Ji murmured, but before he could finish, the stone slab beneath his feet suddenly lit up with dark red patterns. Those patterns resonated with the blood seeping from his palm, forming a miniature formation array. Mo Xiansheng finally spoke, his voice carrying a hint of astonishment: "A Bloodline Resonance Formation? How could something like this be here..."

dialogue.content: "Young one, I've only seen this formation described in the ancient records of the Tianji Record. It's specifically designed for those with a particular bloodline—and the only ones in this world who possess such a bloodline are the Chen family." Mo Xiansheng's tone turned grave, "Someone is waiting for you."

text.content: A chill ran through Chen Ji's heart. Someone was waiting for him? A trap or... He suppressed the unease within him and walked deeper into the ruins following the guidance of the Bloodline Resonance Formation. The murals on both sides of the passage had faded, but one could still faintly make out scenes depicting some kind of ritual—and on that altar, the offering was clearly a broken scroll.

When Chen Ji reached the end of the passage, a small stone chamber came into view. In the center of the chamber stood a stone tablet covered in densely packed small characters. And below the tablet, there was an obvious trace of artificial scraping—the mark was shaped like five fingers, with dried blood still clinging to its edges.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly extended his hand, his fingertips touching that mark. In an instant, a warm sensation spread through his entire body from his fingertips—that was proof of their bloodline connection. He closed his eyes, his voice hoarse: "Niannian... You were definitely here."

text.content: Chen Nian had been missing for several years. In his memory, his sister was still that little girl who followed behind him, calling out "Brother." And now, she had also stepped into this dangerous ruin, arriving here before him. Chen Ji clenched his fist, his fingernails digging deeply into his palm.

The characters on the stone tablet had blurred, but with the faint light from the fourth page of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji barely made out a few lines: "Heavenly fate's chosen one, Chen family's bloodline. To wield the Heavenly Secrets, one must pass three trials..." The subsequent content was illegible due to the passage of time. Mo Xiansheng said solemnly: "This is the orthodox inheritance ceremony of the Tianji Record."

"Orthodox inheritance?" Chen Ji frowned slightly. Wasn't the inheritance of the Tianji Record through fragment contests? How could there be such a ceremony? Mo Xiansheng seemed to see through hispuzzled and explained: "In ancient times, the Tianji Record was an intact object. To wield the Tianji Record, one must pass these three trials... Your sister may have already passed the first trial."

choice.prompt: Beside the stone tablet was a hidden compartment that seemed to require the Chen family's bloodline to activate. Should he carefully investigate this hidden compartment, or first study the content of the three trials on the tablet?

choices.description: The bloodline summoning made it impossible for Chen Ji to ignore any trace his sister might have left, so he directly activated the hidden compartment to see what his sister had left behind.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a small amount of bloodline resonance energy
choices.visible_reward: Discover important clues left by Chen Nian

text.content: Chen Ji pressed his palm against the hidden compartment and urged the Chen family's bloodline within his body. The compartment opened with a sound, and inside lay a jade slip and a yellowed纸条. The handwriting on the paper was beautiful and familiar—it was Chen Nian's handwriting.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji carefully unfolded the paper. There were only a few words on it: "Brother, I found part of the Tianji Record. If you're seeing this, it means you're also investigating the truth. In three days, at the Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds, let's meet up. — Niannian."

choices.description: The three trials might contain important information. Understanding them clearly now will help protect his sister better.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information about the Tianji Record inheritance
choices.risk_hint: May miss the best timing for pursuit
choices.process_label: focus on deciphering the stone tablet

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the urgency in his heart and focused his attention on the stone tablet. With the Tianji Record's assistance in interpretation, he gradually understood the content of the three trials: The first trial was "Bloodline Verification," the second was "Heavenly Secrets Q&A," and the third was "Fate's Choice."

dialogue.content: "Interesting..." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a playful tone, "Since your sister passed the first trial, the Tianji Record fragment she holds is already in a 'verified' state. The fragment you hold has yet to complete verification. So—the fragments you two possess can complement each other."

text.content: Two possibilities lay before him. Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, but in the end, he first opened the hidden compartment beside the tablet—he couldn't ignore any message his sister might have left. The content on the paper made his heart constrict sharply. In three days, at the Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds. She had actually gone to the Xuanwu Sect?

The Xuanwu Sect was one of the three great sects, and Han Lie had come from there. The Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds was known as a deadly place where even Nascent Soul stage experts couldn't escape unharmed. Why would Chen Nian go there? What did she mean by "another part of the Tianji Record"? Countless questions flooded his mind.

dialogue.content: "It seems your sister knows more than you imagined." Mo Xiansheng said faintly, "That the Tianji Record fragments are more than one piece is an open secret. But to find another piece and pass the first trial verification in such a short time... someone is helping her."

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the paper into his chest, his fingers trembling slightly. Who was the person helping Chen Nian? Was it someone from the Holy Sect or another faction? He dared not think the worst, yet he couldn't control those terrifying speculations. "Mo Xiansheng," he said gravely, "If I want to reach the Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds within three days, what should I do?"

choice.prompt: From the ruins to the Xuanwu Sect requires crossing most of the cultivation world. Should he risk using the Tianji Record to foresee the shortest route, or first contact Su Qingyao to use the Tianqing Sect's teleportation formation?

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to Foresee
choices.description: Exchange Heavenly Fate for precise intelligence, ensuring a direct route to the destination without detours.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the optimal route to the Xuanwu Sect, avoiding all dangerous areas
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate is precious to begin with; frequent consumption may affect subsequent plans

dialogue.content: Chen Ji毫不hesitated地催动天机录残页上的微光suddenly大盛，一幅画面在他脑海中浮现：一条隐秘的山道，沿途有三处设有陷阱，但只要从特定的节点穿过，便能在两日内抵达玄武宗边境。

text.content: However, there was one thing in the vision that made Chen Ji frown—the figure he vaguely saw near the third trap was familiar. Han Lie? Why would that brute be there?

choices.description: The Tianqing Sect has dealings with the Xuanwu Sect; using the teleportation formation can get there quickly, but it will expose his whereabouts.
choices.visible_cost: Incurring a favor, and Su Qingyao might interrogate him about his purpose
choices.visible_reward: Arrive safely and quickly, and possibly receive support from the Tianqing Sect
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao's suspicion of Chen Ji might deepen

dialogue.content: Chen Ji took out a communication jade talisman—Su Qingyao had left it for him before. He hesitated for a moment, but still sent the message: "Qingyao Junior Sister, I have an urgent matter and need to go to the Xuanwu Sect. May I borrow your sect's teleportation formation?"

text.content: A moment later, Su Qingyao's reply came: "What are you going to the Xuanwu Sect for? It's not peaceful there right now." Her tone carried obvious wariness. Chen Ji wryly smiled in his heart—this Junior Sister truly still harbored doubts about him.

Just then, Chen Ji noticed a faint restriction on the jade slip. He gently注入一丝spiritual energy, and after the restriction dissipated, a map appeared before his eyes. This map marked multiple routes from the ruins to the Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds, with one particularly marked—it was the route Chen Nian had chosen.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's gaze fell on that marked route, his pupils suddenly contracting. This route... was actually identical to the one he had just foreseen using the Tianji Record. "Is she guiding me?" he murmured, "Or did she know all along that I would come?"

text.content: Mo Xianshengpensive良久，才slowly开口："天机录的持有者之间存在某种mysterious的联系。你妹妹既然已经通过了第一关认证，她对天机录的感知能力应该已经觉醒。她或许……能感知到你的存在。"

Chen Ji gripped the jade slip tightly, an indescribable emotion surging in his heart. His sister had been just a child when she disappeared, and now she had grown to the point of being able to use the Tianji Record and communicate with her brother across a distance. What had she experienced all these years? What had the Holy Sect done to her?

choice.prompt: There seemed to be deeper information hidden within the jade slip. Should he forcibly break through the remaining restriction to check now, or preserve the restriction and wait for his sister to explain in person?

choices.description: Chen Nian might be in danger, and every moment is crucial. He must see all the information now.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger the restriction's self-destruct, with some information permanently lost
choices.visible_reward: Immediately obtain all clues left by Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: After the restriction self-destructs, it cannot be restored; may miss complete information
choices.process_label: risk it to see the truth

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, spiritual energy surging within his body, andabruptly冲击玉简上的restriction. The restriction let out a mournful sound, cracks spreading rapidly—but just as it was about to collapse, a warm force rebounded from the jade slip, deflecting all his attacks.

dialogue.content: A familiar voice emerged from the jade slip, gentle yet firm: "Brother, if you can hear this message, it means you're already looking for me. But there are some things I must tell you in person. Please trust me—wait for me."

choices.text: Preserve the Restriction and Wait for Her
choices.description: Since my sister said she must tell me in person, I should give her this chance. Forcefully prying might destroy the carefully laid plans she left behind.
choices.visible_cost: Waiting for three days increases variables during the process
choices.visible_reward: Maintain trust between siblings, possibly obtaining more complete information
choices.risk_hint: Unexpected events may occur during the three-day wait

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his spiritual energy, the cracks on the restriction gradually healing. He gently stroked the jade slip and murmured: "Alright, I'll wait for you." His voice was soft, yet carried undeniable determination.

Mo Xiansheng seemed quite satisfied with his choice: "You've grown, young one. Understanding restraint and trust—this is the bearing one should have when wielding the Tianji Record." Chen Ji didn't respond, only tucking the jade slip close to his body and turning to walk toward the ruins' exit.

When Chen Ji stepped out of the ruins, the fourth page of the Tianji Record's light completely dimmed, replaced by a warmth he had never felt before. The sensation of bloodline resonance continued, like an invisible thread connecting him tightly with his distant sister.

Three days. The Xuanwu Sect Forbidden Grounds. Chen Ji looked up at the distant horizon, a resolute light flickering in his eyes. No matter how many dangers lay ahead, no matter what secrets his sister carried, he would find her. This time, he absolutely would not lose her again.

When Chen Ji touched the jade slip inscribed with the Chen family's bloodline mark, a blurred image flashed through his mind—Chen Nian was in some dark stone chamber, holding a fragment identical to the one in his hand. The patterns on that fragment resonated with those on his, as if narrating a reunion spanning time and space.
